briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-up today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.2%), a neutral session with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new buys were made; all 7 existing positions are held, consistent with letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage exits automatically rather than reacting to a low-conviction day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Trading discipline means sticking to your rules — like only buying with genuine conviction signals and sufficient cash — instead of forcing a trade just because the market is open. On a neutral day with cash below the buy threshold, the disciplined move is to hold and let existing stop-loss and profit-target rules do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 交易紀律是指堅守既定規則——例如只在有明確訊號和充足現金時才買入——而不是為交易而交易。在市況中性、現金又低於買入門檻的日子，有紀律的做法是持倉不動，讓現有的止蝕和止賺機制自動運作。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted small gains today, with the NASDAQ up 0.4% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, indicating a quiet, directionless session rather than a clear trend. No dominant catalyst drove the move — trading looked like routine consolidation after recent activity. Days like this typically reward patience over forced action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均小幅上漲，納斯達克升0.4%，標普500升0.2%，屬於方向不明的平靜交易日。市場未見明顯催化因素，走勢較似近期upside後的整固。此類日子通常適合按兵不動，而非強行進場。
